title: Uniqueness of the state tape marker
statement: For every natural number $n$, the unary state tape encoding $n$ contains the marker bit $0$ at cell $0$. At every positive natural-number cell $j$, its content is not the marker bit $0$.
replaced:
For every state index $n$, the intact unary state tape encoding $n$ reads the
marker bit $0$ at position $0$, and reads $0$ at no positive natural
position.
